text:
noah_oncall: Heads-up — ap-east dedicated pool 'ded-ap-001' showing control-plane partition + GPU alloc at 96%. Low-priority orgs are getting evicted and we started routing to hosted.
maria_infra: Confirmed. Node flapping on ded-ap-001, some instances NACKing healthchecks. I see kernel OOMs on two workers.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-178 created by noah_oncall. Severity: high. Affected: ded-ap-001 (ap-east). Automated fallback to hosted started for low-priority routes.
ben_plat: Which routes are affected? Are any paid/enterprise orgs at risk?
noah_oncall: Only routes with policy tier=low-priority (free/test). We explicitly excluded committed/reserved orgs. Rebalancing command queued.
maria_infra: Running reweight now — applying hosted weight 0.15 -> 0.55 for generation-ap-east
maria_infra: Command: `rbcli route adjust --route generation-ap-east --weight-hosted 0.55 --who maria_infra`
alex_dev: Suggest also increasing batch interval for low-priority queue so we drop egress token pressure: `config set batch_interval=12ms --selector tier=low-priority`
emily_prod: Heads-up to product/support: little UX blip for free tier only, but callouts in dashboard may show higher latency during shift.
tess_cs: Noted. I'll ping sales if any trial customers report errors. Any chance corp-qa was in low-priority list?
qa_ron: corp-qa is in 'dev-sandbox' and flagged low-priority — they might see reroutes. I'll message them.
noah_oncall: Paste of recent healthcheck logs:
```
2026-03-18T08:15:23Z ded-ap-001 gpu0 mem=98% util=99% evict=1
2026-03-18T08:15:28Z ded-ap-001 kubelet: Pod kube-ded-worker-3 restarted (OOMKilled)
2026-03-18T08:15:34Z controlplane: heartbeat missed from node ded-node-7
```
ben_plat: What's the rollback plan? If hosted takes load, cost goes up — how long can we keep this routing?
maria_infra: Plan: keep low-priority on hosted until ded pool stabilizes and kernel OOM pattern stops for 30m rolling window. Estimate extra cost ~0.8k USD/hr while weight at 0.55. We'll lower to 0.2 once stable and then back to 0.15 over 30m.
alex_dev: Also enabling cache TTL extension for hosted responses for low-priority to reduce token churn: `optimize cache ttl=60s --tag low-priority` — reduces cost impact.
ops-bot: Note: autoscaler in ded-ap is disabled for emergency, not to trigger more churn. Manual approval required to re-enable.
emily_prod: Any customer-visible error spikes to call out on status page? We should post a brief note: "Low-priority developer sandboxes may experience elevated latency; paid customers unaffected." Approve?
noah_oncall: Approve. I'll post once we have confirmation from QA that corp-qa is stable on hosted.
qa_ron: corp-qa confirmed degraded but functional on hosted. They see ~300ms extra tail latency on generation.
tess_cs: Thanks — I'll update the trial onboarding thread.
maria_infra: Pool is starting to drain faulting nodes, kernel OOM root cause looks like a driver bug on a specific kernel build. Patch in testing; will roll to nodes in 10m.
noah_oncall: Marking incident: monitoring for 60m after patch. If stable, we'll move weight back: hosted 0.55 -> 0.2 over 15m then ->0.15. Closing communication loop after rollback.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-178 updated: mitigation in progress. Next update in 10m. :white_check_mark:
